# [Perks active again] SPECIAL's punch card machine temporarily disabled!

![\[Perks active again\] SPECIALs punch card machine temporarily deactivated!](/uploads/526_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update June 12, 2025] Perks active again!

Hey @Fallout 76 News,

A small server-side update has been deployed to reenable the following Perk Cards:

- Cola Nut,
- Super Duper,
-Ammo Smith,
- chemist,
- Party Boy/Girl,
- Cap Collector,
- Butcher's Bounty,
- Can Do!,
- Scrounger,
- Pharma Farma,
- Woodchucker,
- Glowing Hunter,
- Green Thumb,
- scrappers,
If you have any issues equipping any of the listed Perk Cards or if you believe their effect is not working, please close and relaunch the game. For any lingering issues after the update, please reach out to Bethesda Support.

Thank you all for your patience as the team addressed this issue.

Source: Discord

[Update June 10, 2025] More deactivated perk cards

We have just added Green Thumb and Scrapper to the list of Perks that have been disabled while the team works towards a fix. Thank you for your patience, everyone! @Fallout 76 News

Source: Discord

[Update June 10, 2025] The punch card machines are activated again, but perk cards are deactivated.

Hey @Fallout 76 News,

We wanted to provide you with a quick update since yesterday’s announcement that the Punch Card Machine was disabled. Today the team rolled out a server-side update that re-enabled the Punch Card Machine and disabled the following Perk Cards:

- Cola Nut
- Super duper
-Ammo Smith
- Chemist
- Party Boy/Girl
- Cap Collector
- Butcher's Bounty
- Can Do!
- Scrounger
- Pharma Farma
- Woodchucker
- Glowing Hunter
We recommend that you close and relaunch the game if you’re having any issues with the Punch Card Machine. We will have another update coming later this week to reenable the Perks mentioned above.

As a general reminder, the usage of exploits goes against our Terms of Service and will put your account at risk of being banned. Please protect your accounts by refusing the siren call of “EZ” Caps.

Attention: Bethesda has currently deactivated the SPECIALs punch card machine. There are unexpected issues affecting gameplay and server stability.

The Bethesda team is working on a hotfix to resolve the issue. More information will follow shortly.

The loadout slot offers in the Atom Shop will also be temporarily deactivated from Tuesday.

### Bethesda Game Studios #76 announcements

Hopefully most of you aren't stuck in your crafting loadout and can get by so far. A date for the hotfix is ​​not yet known. As soon as there is information about this, you will find out about it here.

The background appears to be exploits that were shared on Facebook, YouTube and other social networks, with which the punch card machine could be misused in order to gain massive advantages.

There is also a lot of feedback from players on Reddit about the official announcement: Reddit Thread.
